spec.name: sprint32_kalshi_polymarket_spread_monitor
spec.hypothesis: Cross-venue price discrepancies on identically-worded Kalshi/Polymarket contracts persist net of fees often enough and large enough to be tradeable; measure before trading.
spec.power_argument: MONITORING PHASE, not a scored trial: no trade signal, no t-test yet. Need >=300 matched-contract observations to estimate spread frequency/size distribution before any validation spec can state a min-detectable-edge. Deferred until real fee schedules are pulled.

params.note: requires new data.py connector; will fail validate_spec as-is; submitting for principal/backtest_auditor build authorization, not automated registration
